task.title: Add optimistic web mutation queue
task.description:
Make web mutations render immediately while HTTP success remains Git-durable. Send the client-observed task head, queue pending intents sequentially per task, persist independent tasks concurrently, reconcile confirmed responses, roll back failed intents without clobbering later actions, surface stale-head conflicts, and cover projection and request races.

Also bring the board onto the auto-sync workflow from WB-01KYT0RX395F6VG7RYZSZTF1A3, which deliberately left `serve` local-only. Apply the same fetch-before/push-after behavior to web mutations, show the current auto-sync state in the UI, and let the user toggle it to shift modes. The optimistic queue is what makes this viable: mutations render immediately while the fetch and targeted push settle behind them, so network latency never blocks the board.
